references.text: Describes the laws concerning a woman's menstruation (נִדָּה) and impurity, as summarized in verse 33
Concerns a man's discharge (זָב), which is mentioned in the summary of verse 33
Deals with a woman's abnormal bleeding outside of her menstrual period, which is part of the summary in verse 33
Prohibits sexual intercourse with a woman during her menstrual period, relating to 'the one who lies with an unclean woman'
Repeats the prohibition against intercourse with a menstruating woman and sets out the penalty
Ezekiel uses menstrual impurity as a metaphor for Israel's sin and uncleanness
Condemns those who have sexual relations with a woman during her menstrual period
Compares the impurity after childbirth to the impurity of menstruation (נִדָּה)
